title: Concurrency & distribution -- where it stands
thesis: An unusual shape: the substrates are complete and excellent, while the vocabulary over them is design-only. Three sub-planes ship, each heavily guarded with real multi-process tests -- OTP-style supervised nodes, a measured-gated multicore tier, an elastic HTTP worker fleet -- over a full libuv reactor with mTLS. What is not built is the plane's own headline: the one routing vocabulary (Concurrently()) that would let you say 'do this concurrently' and land it on the right substrate.

lanes.note: Share-nothing stzNode with an engine-enforced bounded inbox, On(tag,f) dispatch, location-transparent Send/Ask over STZM; guarded with real OS processes.
lanes.proof: stzNode, stzNodePlane, stzm.zig; D0-D2 guards under test/cluster

lanes.note: OneForOne/AllForOne, a restart budget with escalation, heartbeats, death-notice monitors; proven by surviving vs wiped state under real kills.
Share-nothing OS processes exchanging STZM frames over reactor TCP/mTLS, topology as data, Deploy moves a node in one line; guarded end-to-end D4-D6.
lanes.proof: SOFTANZA_DISTRIBUTION_PLAN.md; D4-D6 guards (semantic-search node Deploy'd and killed mid-run)

lanes.note: Five parallel sites behind a measured calib.Gate: matmul, LU, reductions, kNN/distance; 2.7-6.7x; elementwise killed by the memory wall.
Vendored libuv on its own thread, submit -> ticket -> await, no callback crosses into Haro; timers, TCP, subprocess, curl HTTPS, HTTP/STZM/TLS listeners.
stzWorkerPool, 3-tier stzRequestClassifier, stzAppCluster, stzClusterSupervisor autoscaling on /health, p50-p99 telemetry; guarded with a real 3-process fleet.
Retry-with-failover, circuit breakers, token-bucket rate limiting, at-most-once delivery, mandatory timeouts; fleet-scoped, thinner than a service mesh.
HTTP client sync + async, TCP client/server, URL parsing, DNS; framing fuzzed and property-tested; no UDP, WebSocket is curl-based.
Mutual TLS via vendored mbedTLS: server require_client, client reactor_connect_tls, a reactor-free smoke guard; test certs only, no PKI lifecycle.
stzComputeFederation: Join, a governance lattice (risk/grant/authority), FederatedCall over reactor async curl; facet discovery still HTTP (D5 residue).
Distribution routes named work only; no Ray-style task graph with dependency scheduling; the plan refuses it until a workload earns it.
Plan of record CN0-CN5 (Concurrently(), stzTask, ticket, stzWorkshop); no code exists, base/concurrent/ holds only the plan, its test dir is empty.

standouts: OTP-style supervision proven under real kills -- the pragmatic 80% of Erlang in a non-BEAM language
A measured-gated multicore tier: bit-identical or justified, elementwise killed by the memory wall
A full libuv reactor where no callback crosses into Haro (submit -> ticket -> await)
An elastic HTTP worker fleet with a smart router and autoscaling, guarded with a real 3-process fleet
gaps: Federation over the node plane; UDP and a native WebSocket; a managed-PKI mTLS story
Dynamic task-graph distribution and live multi-machine verification
